pa-setup.description: Onboarding — locates/creates the shared agent memory folder (asking about existing/synced memory first) and collects required fields for every registered capability.

pa-log.description: Captures a structured entry (idea, task, observation, etc.) into the persistent log for later recall during planning and decision-making.

pa-add-log-field.description: Registers a new log field/category in the log schema so future log entries can use it.

pa-add-func.description: Adds a new capability to personal-assistant — registers it in modules.json and scaffolds its skill file.

pa-forget.description: Soft-deletes an entry from the log (marks it forgotten rather than erasing it) when it's outdated, mistaken, or no longer relevant.

pa-recall.description: Reads or searches the shared _agent-memory log and answers in plain language. Read-only.
